title: Pipeline test characterization
statement: For all $n,m\in\mathbb{N}$ and bit strings $G_1,G_2,r$, the pipeline applied to the encoding of $n$, $m$, $G_1$, $G_2$, and $r$ returns true exactly when, for every integer $j$ with $0\le j<8(m+12)$, the two gate evaluations modulo the modulus specified by the $j$th raw block of $r$ agree. In each evaluation, the context is formed from $n$, that raw block, and the list of input points specified by the corresponding blocks of $r$, and the gate lists are $G_1$ and $G_2$.
caveat: The statement compares compound bit-string procedures whose definitions are not informally specified in the supplied definitions.
